report.summary: Notification service experienced intermittent push and SMS sending failures starting at 13:25 UTC due to DNS resolution failures (getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN), caused by a CoreDNS replica scale-down from 4 to 1 for cost optimisation at 13:22 UTC.

ranked_hypotheses.title: CoreDNS Replicas Scaled Down Causing DNS Resolution Timeouts

supporting.note: CoreDNS replicas scaled from 4 to 1 at 13:22 UTC, immediately preceding the latency and error spikes.
CoreDNS p99 latency spiked starting at 13:23 UTC, reaching over 2,112 ms.
CoreDNS error rate jumped starting at 13:23 UTC to ~22%.
CoreDNS CPU usage spiked to over 105% immediately after the scale-down.
Notification service error rate spiked to ~26.58% starting at 13:25 UTC.
Logs show continuous getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN errors resolving fcm.push-provider.example.com starting at 13:25 UTC.
Logs show continuous getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN errors resolving sms-vendor.example.net starting at 13:25 UTC.

contradicting.note: Errors are local DNS resolution failures (getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN), not HTTP or connection failures from successfully resolved vendor endpoints.
The exact timing of failures directly correlates with DNS infrastructure downscaling rather than external vendor incidents.

facts.text: CoreDNS replicas were scaled down from 4 to 1 at 2026-10-14T13:22:00+00:00.
CoreDNS latency, CPU usage, and error rate spiked starting at 2026-10-14T13:23:00+00:00.
notification-service error rate spiked starting at 2026-10-14T13:25:00+00:00, reaching a peak of 26.58%.
notification-service logged getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN errors for sms-vendor.example.net and fcm.push-provider.example.com starting at 2026-10-14T13:25:00+00:00.

assumptions: Reducing CoreDNS replicas from 4 to 1 resulted in severe resource exhaustion and query throttling, causing DNS resolution requests to time out.
evidence_gaps: Metrics for other services depending on CoreDNS were not reviewed in detail, although notification-service clearly captures the impact.

timeline.event: CoreDNS latency, error rate, and CPU metrics begin spiking
notification-service error rate increases and getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN errors begin
Incident INC-11 reported by on-call SRE

recommended_actions.action: Scale CoreDNS back up to 4 replicas
recommended_actions.rationale: Restores cluster DNS capacity, resolves query throttling, and stops notification failures.

recommended_actions.action: Implement minimum replica limits for platform infrastructure services
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents accidental single-replica downscaling of critical shared components like CoreDNS.
